title: Typed layer operations
description: The public entrypoints of the typed API (library 0.3). Where several types have the same method (Of, TryOf, Parse, FromJson, AddDays, CompareTo), one entity names a representative entrypoint and lists the others in its sources. Accessors (Year, DayOfWeek, ZoneId, …) are left out.

entities.name: Construct a civil value
entities.description: CivilDate.Of, CivilYearMonth.Of, CivilTime.Of and CivilDateTime.Of build a value that is valid by construction, or throw.
entities.transport: static method of CivilDate (and of CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime)
entities.result: The value. Years are BigInteger, so 275760 and -500 are ordinary dates.
failures: ArgumentOutOfRangeException, named after the field (day, month, hour, second, nanosecond), when TryOf would not return Unique: a day missing from the month, month outside 1..12, a time field out of range, or second 60.

entities.name: Try to construct a civil value
entities.description: CivilDate.TryOf and its siblings return an outcome instead of throwing. The fields are written as UTV JSON and read back through the JSON layer's checks.
entities.transport: static method of CivilDate (and of CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime)
entities.result: Outcome<T>.Unique with the value.
failures: Invalid (day-out-of-range) when the day is missing from the month, such as 30 February or 29 February in a common year.
Invalid (month-out-of-range) for a month outside 1..12.
Invalid (field-out-of-range) for an hour, minute, second or nanosecond out of range.
Unsupported (leap-second) for second 60.

entities.name: Parse text into a typed value
entities.description: T.Parse(text) reads the text form into the type asked for; Temporal.Parse(text) reads any text-form value as an ITemporalValue. Parsing never throws for bad input.
entities.transport: static method of Temporal (and Parse on every type except PosixSeconds and ElapsedSeconds)
entities.result: Outcome<T>.Unique with the value: an Instant for text ending in Z, a FixedOffsetDateTime for +00:00, a ZonedIntent for [Area/Location], a Period for P…, an Interval for bracket or slash notation.
failures: Invalid (syntax) for text outside the grammar.
Invalid (day-out-of-range, month-out-of-range, field-out-of-range, offset-out-of-range) for out-of-range fields.
Invalid (kind-mismatch) when the text is another kind of value than the type asked for, or an interval mixes kinds of point.
Invalid (reversed-interval) for an interval that ends before it starts.
Unsupported (unsupported-form) for week dates, ordinal dates, basic format, a year alone, decimal period components, EDTF qualifiers and intervals with no point.
Unsupported (unsupported-annotation) for any annotation other than one [Area/Location], and for Z or -00:00 followed by a zone.
Unsupported (leap-second, end-of-day, implementation-limit) for second 60, 24:00 and more than nine fraction digits.

entities.name: Read UTV JSON into a typed value
entities.description: T.FromJson(json) and Temporal.FromJson(json) validate the JSON structurally, read it, and check that the typed value holds every property of the input.
entities.transport: static method of Temporal (and FromJson on every typed value)
entities.result: Outcome<T>.Unique with the value; ToJson() of it gives back the same JSON.
failures: Invalid (malformed-value, followed by the structural codes such as duplicate-key or missing-property) for JSON that is not a well-formed UTV value.
Unsupported (unsupported-version) for a newer specification version.
Invalid (kind-mismatch) when the value is another kind or form than the type asked for.
Unsupported (unsupported-operand) for a valid value no typed type holds: another kind, a zoned date, a floating date-time with a resolutionPolicy, extra properties.
Unsupported (unsupported-calendar) for a non-Gregorian calendar.
Invalid (day-out-of-range and the like) for a civil value that names no real date or time.
Invalid (reversed-interval) and Unsupported (unsupported-form) for intervals that are reversed or have no point.
Unsupported (implementation-limit) for a period component beyond 64 bits.

entities.name: Add days, weeks, hours, minutes or seconds
entities.description: The total additions: AddDays and AddWeeks on CivilDate; AddDays, AddWeeks, AddHours, AddMinutes and AddSeconds on CivilDateTime and ZonedIntent (wall-clock arithmetic, carrying into days); AddMonths and AddYears on CivilYearMonth.
entities.transport: method of CivilDate, CivilDateTime, ZonedIntent and CivilYearMonth
entities.result: A new value. A ZonedIntent keeps its zone and wall time (noon plus one day is noon, across a DST change) and drops an asserted offset.

entities.name: Add months or years
entities.description: AddMonths(n) and AddYears(n) on CivilDate, AddMonths(n) on CivilDateTime and ZonedIntent: the partial form, which refuses a missing day.
entities.transport: method of CivilDate, CivilDateTime and ZonedIntent
entities.result: Outcome<T>.Unique with the later value when the day exists in the target month.
failures: None (month-end) when the day is missing from the target month: 31 January plus one month.

entities.name: Add months or years, clamping to the month's end
entities.description: AddMonths(n, MonthEnd.Constrain) and AddYears(n, MonthEnd.Constrain): the total overloads, which always answer.
entities.transport: method of CivilDate (AddMonths, AddYears) and CivilDateTime (AddMonths)
entities.result: The later value, clamped to the last day of the month (31 January plus one month is 28 February 2026).
failures: ArgumentException when the policy is MonthEnd.Reject: the rejecting form is the overload without a policy.

entities.name: Add a period
entities.description: CivilDate.Add(Period[, MonthEnd]) and CivilDateTime.Add(Period[, MonthEnd]): years and months first, then the month-end rule, then weeks and days, then hours, minutes and seconds on the wall clock.
entities.result: Outcome<T>.Unique with the later value.
failures: None (month-end) when the day is missing after the months and the policy is MonthEnd.Reject (the default).
Invalid (kind-mismatch) when a period with hours, minutes or seconds is added to a CivilDate.

entities.name: Count days between two dates
entities.description: CivilDate.DaysUntil(other): other minus this, in days.
entities.result: A long; 5 November to 25 December is 50.

entities.name: Order two values whose order needs no rules
entities.description: CompareTo and the < > <= >= operators on CivilDate, CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime (by instant) and Instant. A missing second compares as 0. ZonedIntent has neither.
entities.transport: method and operators of CivilDate (and of the other rule-free types)
entities.result: An int (negative, zero, positive) or a bool from the operators; null compares before any value.

entities.name: Follow a time zone
entities.description: CivilDateTime.InZone(zoneId): the same wall time, now an intention in an IANA zone. No rules are needed or read.
entities.result: A ZonedIntent with no asserted offset.
failures: ArgumentException for a null or empty id, or one that is not an IANA zone name such as Europe/Paris.

entities.name: Pin a fixed offset
entities.description: CivilDateTime.AtOffset(seconds) keeps the wall time at that offset; Instant.AtOffset(seconds) shows the instant's wall time there.
entities.result: A FixedOffsetDateTime.
failures: ArgumentOutOfRangeException for an offset beyond ±18:00 (64800 s).

entities.name: Turn a fixed-offset date-time into an instant
entities.description: FixedOffsetDateTime.ToInstant(): exact, and needs no rules.
entities.result: The Instant.

entities.name: Hold zone rules in a context
entities.description: TemporalContext.With(rules): the only way to give typed operations zone rules. There is no default or ambient context.
entities.result: A TemporalContext whose Rules are the bundle given.
failures: ArgumentNullException for null rules.

entities.name: Resolve a zoned intention to an instant
entities.description: ZonedIntent.Resolve(ctx[, policy]), and its Gap and Overlap overloads, which call TemporalContext.Resolve. Without a policy it is ResolutionPolicy.Strict.
entities.transport: method of ZonedIntent and of TemporalContext
entities.result: Outcome<Instant>.Unique when the wall time happens once, or when Gap.ShiftForward, Overlap.Earliest or Overlap.Latest picks one.
failures: None (gap) when the wall time falls in a gap and the gap policy is Reject or PreserveUnresolved.
Multiple with both instants, ascending, in an overlap under Overlap.Reject (with ambiguous) or Overlap.All (without).
Invalid (offset-mismatch) when an asserted offset is not in force at that wall time, including any assertion in a gap.
Unsupported (unknown-zone) for a zone not in the context's rules.
Unsupported (outside-rule-window) within a day of the rules' validity window or outside it.
Unsupported (unsupported-policy) for a ResolutionPolicy built from GapPolicy or OverlapPolicy values that are not implemented.

entities.name: See an instant's wall time in a zone
entities.description: Instant.InZone(zoneId, ctx), which calls TemporalContext.InZone.
entities.transport: method of Instant and of TemporalContext
entities.result: Outcome<ZonedIntent>.Unique with seconds always present and the offset in force as the asserted offset.
failures: Unsupported (unknown-zone) for a zone not in the rules.
Unsupported (outside-rule-window) for an instant outside the rules' validity window.

entities.name: Order zoned values
entities.description: TemporalContext.Compare(a, b) for two ZonedIntents, or a ZonedIntent and an Instant: both are resolved strictly, then every pair of candidates is compared.
entities.result: Outcome<Ordering>.Unique when every pair of candidates gives the same order.
failures: Multiple (ambiguous) with the possible orderings when the order depends on which side of a DST overlap is meant.
None, Invalid or Unsupported, with that side's diagnostics (gap, offset-mismatch, unknown-zone, outside-rule-window), when a side does not resolve to one or more instants.

entities.name: Add POSIX seconds to an instant
entities.description: Instant.Add(PosixSeconds) and the + operator: exact rational arithmetic.
entities.result: The later Instant.

entities.name: Add SI seconds to an instant
entities.description: Instant.Add(ElapsedSeconds): SI seconds on a POSIX coordinate.
entities.result: Never Unique in this library.
failures: Unsupported (needs-leap-seconds) always: it needs a leap-second table, which this library does not ship.

entities.name: Measure POSIX seconds between instants
entities.description: Instant.Until(other): other minus this, exactly.
entities.result: PosixSeconds as a reduced rational, such as 14403/4 s.

entities.name: Make an instant from Unix time
entities.description: Instant.FromUnixSeconds(seconds, nanoseconds) and Instant.FromUnixNanoseconds(n).
entities.result: An Instant with all nine nanosecond digits kept exactly.
failures: ArgumentOutOfRangeException for nanoseconds outside 0..999,999,999 (FromUnixSeconds).

entities.name: Make a period or a second count
entities.description: Period.Of, Period.Days, Period.Months and the other component builders; PosixSeconds.Of and ElapsedSeconds.Of, whole or as numerator and denominator; Negate on each.
entities.transport: static method of Period, PosixSeconds and ElapsedSeconds
entities.result: The amount. Period.Months(1) is P1M, never PT1M; Period.Days(1) is not 86,400 seconds.
failures: ArgumentOutOfRangeException from the rational for a zero denominator (PosixSeconds.Of, ElapsedSeconds.Of).
OverflowException from Period.Negate when a component is long.MinValue.

entities.name: Make an interval
entities.description: Interval.HalfOpen(a, b), Interval.Closed(a, b) and Interval.Of(start, end) with Bound.Included, Bound.Excluded, Bound.Unbounded and Bound.Unknown, over CivilDate or Instant.
entities.result: An Interval<T>.
failures: ArgumentException (reversed-interval) when the end is before the start.
ArgumentException (unsupported-form) when neither end has a point.

entities.name: Ask whether an interval contains a point or overlaps another
entities.description: Interval<T>.Contains(point) and Interval<T>.Overlaps(other), with three-valued answers.
entities.result: Truth.Definitely, Truth.Possibly (an unknown end decides it) or Truth.Impossible.

entities.name: Bring a .NET value in
entities.description: CivilDate.FromDateOnly, CivilTime.FromTimeOnly, CivilDateTime.FromDateTime, Instant.FromDateTime, Instant.FromDateTimeOffset, FixedOffsetDateTime.FromDateTimeOffset and PosixSeconds.FromTimeSpan: the method's type names the intent.
entities.transport: static method of CivilDate, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, Instant, FixedOffsetDateTime and PosixSeconds
entities.result: The typed value: a plain value where every input converts (DateOnly, TimeOnly, DateTimeOffset, TimeSpan), an Outcome for DateTime.
failures: Unsupported (local-zone) for a DateTimeKind.Local value: the host's zone is never read.
Invalid (intent-required) for a DateTimeKind.Utc value given to CivilDateTime.FromDateTime, or a DateTimeKind.Unspecified value given to Instant.FromDateTime.

entities.name: Convert back to .NET
entities.description: CivilDate.ToDateOnly, CivilTime.ToTimeOnly, CivilDateTime.ToDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime.ToDateTimeOffset, Instant.ToDateTimeOffset and PosixSeconds.ToTimeSpan.
entities.transport: method of CivilDate, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime, Instant and PosixSeconds
entities.result: Outcome<T>.Unique with the .NET value; a FixedOffsetDateTime that came from a DateTimeOffset gives back an EqualsExact copy. An Instant is shown at +00:00 with an info diagnostic offset-not-known.
failures: Unsupported (out-of-native-range) for years outside 1..9999, nanoseconds that are not a multiple of 100, offsets that are not whole minutes or are beyond ±14:00, and amounts beyond TimeSpan's range.

entities.name: Take the one answer of an outcome
entities.description: Outcome<T>.Single(), with TryGetUnique(out value) and UniqueOr(fallback) as the non-throwing forms. None of them ever picks among several answers.
entities.result: The value of a Unique outcome.
failures: OutcomeException, carrying the status and diagnostics, for Multiple, None, Unsupported and Invalid.

entities.name: Bridge an outcome to the JSON layer
entities.description: Outcome<T>.ToResult(): the utv-result/1.0 envelope of the 0.2 JSON layer.
entities.result: A UtvResult with the operation's name, the status, the diagnostics and the candidates as UTV JSON (or wire strings for Ordering and Truth).
failures: NotSupportedException for a Unique or Multiple outcome whose values have no UTV JSON, such as a .NET DateOnly.

relatedViews.relationship: The typed layer's features these operations carry out.
The JSON-layer operations each typed operation calls.
